title: AI Laser Locking for Quantum Computers: How QuEra Automates It
summary: QuEra is using AI to automate the laser locking and tuning process for their neutral atom quantum computers, replacing error-prone manual calibration with machine learning models that can continuously monitor and adjust laser frequencies critical for qubit operations.
problem_solved: Solves the challenge of maintaining precise, stable laser frequencies for quantum operations in neutral atom quantum computers, which traditionally requires constant manual tuning by experts.
why_valuable: Enables scalable and reliable quantum computing by automating one of the most delicate and labor-intensive calibration processes in quantum hardware.
